novelty_search.nearest_positive: aspectual_anchor.has_vs_had.rank1_donor_free_margin_reflection_v1 chooses alpha with a per-row target-guided 257-point head grid.
novelty_search.nearest_null: aspectual_anchor.has_vs_had.direction_prototype_carrier_actuation_v2 uses two direction means and retains only about 22% of v10 recovery.
novelty_search.new_question: Does the source state's fixed has-versus-had confidence predict the missing row-specific carrier gain with only an intercept and slope per direction?

selection_disclosure: The affine form was chosen after inspecting correlations between v10 target-guided alpha and the fixed has/had margin, including the existing fresh population. The coefficients use only the frozen 16-row lexical selection IDs, and the intervention at the affine alpha has never been run, but this rung cannot establish prospective held-out prediction. A passing result requires a new-text preregistration before identification.

frozen_predictor.feature: At the intervention source state, confidence = logit(current tense token) - logit(other tense token), using globally fixed token IDs has=468 and had=550. No row answer/foil IDs are consulted to compute this feature.
frozen_predictor.direction_rule: A uses its registered tense direction; P and C use present_to_past for even group_number and past_to_present for odd group_number, as in v2.
frozen_predictor.fit_population: The 16 lexical row IDs tagged selection in the immutable scalar-term result; response is the immutable v10 per-row target-guided alpha.
frozen_predictor.actuator: alpha = intercept[direction] + slope[direction] * confidence; x_patched = x_source + alpha*q. No confirmation donor activation, row target/foil ID, grid, or outcome selects alpha.

predictions.pred_a_authority_fit_source_capability_a: All authority hashes, exact coefficient reconstruction, all scored source-side native capability, and exact-head replay pass. Unused C donors are not capability-gated.
predictions.pred_b_fixed_input_conditioned_actuator: Exactly four finite frozen coefficients and the two fixed token IDs select every alpha; no confirmation donor activation, row answer/foil ID, grid, or outcome participates.
predictions.pred_c_fresh_A_prediction: A1 and A2 each have mean recovery >=0.75, direction fraction >=0.75, recovery/v10 >=0.65, and recovery/v2 >=2.0.
predictions.pred_d_fresh_P_generalization: P has mean reflection >=0.75, direction fraction >=0.75, and reflection/v2 >=2.0.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage_and_price: All 64 rows are unique within 25 model forwards, 200 example evaluations, exactly 176 selected-head pair evaluations, zero grids/backwards/updates, and four fit parameters.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: source-state confidence supplies the input-dependent rank-one carrier gain on this design-seen population.
terminal.null: Authority, actuator identity, and coverage pass but A/P prediction or C selectivity misses; a fixed has/had-margin affine rule is insufficient.
terminal.invalid: Authority, coefficient reconstruction, scored-source capability, head control, actuator identity, or coverage fails.

circuit_targets: held-out/OOD prediction (screen only here; new text required next)
